as_above.purpose: Validate staged imports and record their SHA-256 checksums as an auditable receipt (local-only, no network).
nonnegotiables: No external network access during validation
Declared artifacts restricted to the five staged imports
Stop on missing artifacts or invalid structure
procedure_steps: Validate spec structure (required keys and types)
Confirm each declared artifact exists and is readable
Compute SHA-256 for each declared artifact path
Append one receipt line per artifact: <sha256>  <path>  <utc_iso8601>

so_below.purpose_human: Truth Bomb v2 makes a verifiable, human-readable receipt ledger by hashing a fixed set of staged files (imports) locally.
ux_notes: Imports may be symlinks; hashing resolves actual file bytes.
Receipts are append-only; each run adds new lines with timestamps.
This is intentionally local-only: no network calls.
success_criteria: All staged imports exist at uhd/imports/*
Checksums ledger gains 5 new lines (one per artifact)
